ValidationRule.description: Probability must match the stage ladder within 10 points, and discount rises only up to sqrt-scaled caps for the amount.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ABS(Probability - CASE(TEXT(StageName), 'Prospecting', 10, 'Qualification', 20, 'Needs Analysis', 40, 'Proposal/Price Quote', 60, 'Negotiation/Review', 80, 'Closed Won', 100, 'Closed Lost', 0, Probability)) > 10, AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Discount_Pct__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Amount)), Discount_Pct__c > MIN(0.5, 0.05 + SQRT(MAX(1, Amount)) / 2000)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Probability or discount does not fit the stage/amount.
